decisions.decision:
Pitch cadence: (A). The $999 Tantra Pro course is pitched only at the close of Day 3. Finish all of T-129 now, every edit through pass.py:
1) Add an em dash and en dash check to pass.py validate, and add a test that makes it fail on either.
2) Remove meta.day1. Dates come from cohort.ts (weekly Wed to Fri, 11:00 ET).
3) Give every open task with a past due date a new due date: P0 and P1 2026-10-14, P2 2026-10-16, P3 2026-10-23. Clear the due date where nothing depends on a deadline.
4) Confirm T-070's title has no 'Build Pass' (it already looks retitled to the paid seat). Leave it on hold.
5) Change T-071's spec from 'every day from Day 1' to 'close of Day 3 only'. Check the deck (build/*.py → deck.html) and the s4-challenge guide say the same, and fix any drift.
6) Mark H042 to H055 fixed in AUDIT.md. Run validate, republish, then move to review for Amal.
decisions.why: (A) matches the deck and the s4-challenge guide (A-from-D audit says the deck pitches only at the close). Claude recommended it in T-129. weekly-cohort-schedule bans literal cohort dates. orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09) says Claude makes this call.
